tool_args.rationale: The earlier submission failed because prediction parameters were never initialized through the expected fit/predict interface. This implementation fits all four specified parameters numerically, stores them at module scope, and applies the recalled mechanism with tau_scale=3.0; the broad s_grad range makes another probe unnecessary.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The recalled mechanism calls for this probe only when the s_grad span is below 0.08; observed span is 2.0, so it is unnecessary.
The barrier-activation and sink-gradient signatures support the recalled four-parameter siphon law instead.
It predicts high-u_now decline, unlike the observed overall increase across the paid rows.
It is explicitly irrelevant and would add cost without resolving model identification.
